articles.title: Tesla driver wanted after 2 police officers struck during Oshawa arrest investigation
articles.summary: Durham police are searching for a 23-year-old Ajax man after two officers were struck by a Tesla SUV during an investigation that began with a traffic stop and led to the seizure of a replica firearm and drugs. The incident unfolded in the early morning hours of Sept. 22, when officers were conducting proactive patrols […]

articles.title: ‘It really does not feel like one country’: Emily St. John Mandel on living in a divided America
articles.summary: Canadian-American author Emily St. John Mandel has been hailed as a prognosticator since the onset of the COVID-19 pandemic, which some described as bearing an eerie similarity to her book "Station Eleven."

articles.title: Mayoral candidate Dipika Damerla calls for independent auditor general in Mississauga
articles.summary: With just a few weeks until voters head to the polls in the Mississauga municipal election, mayoral candidate Dipika Damerla is calling for the city to have an independent auditor general. Pointing to other major cities with an independent auditor general in Ontario, Damerla says this is something the city has needed for a long […]

articles.title: Scarborough’s busway is open: What commuters need to know
articles.summary: The long-awaited Scarborough busway is set to open in just a few days. It will replace the route that the now-defunct Line 3 TTC line used to run. CBC’s Mercedes Gaztambide gives you an inside look at the new bus.

articles.title: Crews clean up 2nd spill at Scarborough creek linked to subway extension work
articles.summary: Crews from the city and the province have cleaned up a second spill in Scarborough's West Highland Creek linked to work on a subway extension in the area.
